incompatibility_reason: Core Body Temperature (rectal/bolus implant ~38.5C). CattleCare has DHT11 which measures ambient temperature only.
biological_technical_justification: Internal physiological core body temperature cannot be measured by an external collar sensor without physical thermal contact or invasive bolus.
safety_action: Retain in raw archive; isolate in data/processed/excluded_research_data/cbt/

biological_technical_justification: CattleCare hardware consists of ESP32 + MPU6050 + DHT11; no barometric pressure sensor (e.g. BMP280) is present on the neckband.
safety_action: Retain in raw archive; isolate in data/processed/excluded_research_data/pressure/

incompatibility_reason: Ultra-Wideband 3D indoor position coordinates (coord_x_cm, coord_y_cm, coord_z_cm).
biological_technical_justification: Requires high-frequency UWB transceivers and synchronized fixed barn anchor infrastructure; unsupported by CattleCare collar.
safety_action: Retain in raw archive; isolate in data/processed/excluded_research_data/uwb/

incompatibility_reason: UWB anchor ranging distances, sample statistics, and LOS probabilities.
biological_technical_justification: Incompatible with CattleCare hardware; ESP32 Wi-Fi does not perform UWB time-of-flight ranging.
safety_action: Retain in raw archive; isolate in data/processed/excluded_research_data/uwb_distance/

biological_technical_justification: Physically incompatible sensor location. Ankle acceleration measures leg swinging and pedometer steps; CattleCare is exclusively a neckband collar.
safety_action: Retain in raw archive; isolate in data/processed/excluded_research_data/ankle_accel/

incompatibility_reason: Milking parlor milk weight and Days In Milk (DIM).
biological_technical_justification: Production metric collected during parlor milking; unsupported by wearable collar sensors. Explicitly excluded per user specification.
safety_action: Retain in raw archive; isolate in data/processed/excluded_research_data/milk/

incompatibility_reason: Multi-camera computer vision spatial coordinates (loc_x_cm, loc_y_cm, loc_z_cm).
biological_technical_justification: Extracted from overhead barn cameras; impossible to measure directly from collar hardware.
safety_action: Retain in raw archive; isolate in data/processed/excluded_research_data/visual_location/

incompatibility_reason: External weather station files (15 Excel sheets, maps.png, docx).
biological_technical_justification: Regional meteorological station observations away from the barn; replaced by local CattleCare DHT11 microclimate data.
safety_action: Retain in raw archive; isolate in data/processed/excluded_research_data/weather/

incompatibility_reason: Stationary reference tags fixed to barn structures, not attached to any living cow.
biological_technical_justification: Non-animal calibration nodes. Keeping them in the training dataset would introduce static, non-biological noise.
safety_action: Retain in raw archive; exclude from training dataset.

incompatibility_reason: Ground-truth behavior labels exist for C11-C16, but NO matching collar IMMU sensors exist in the dataset (only T01-T10 were deployed on cows).
biological_technical_justification: Cannot train a supervised model without input features. Preserved as research benchmark ground truth.
safety_action: Retain in raw archive; exclude from paired supervised training dataset.

incompatibility_reason: 3-axis magnetic flux density columns inside otherwise compatible IMMU files.
biological_technical_justification: MPU6050 does not contain a magnetometer; stripping these columns ensures the ML model does not learn dependencies on unsupported hardware channels.
safety_action: Drop columns during feature extraction for hardware-compatible dataset.

biological_technical_justification: MPU6050 gyroscope cannot maintain absolute magnetic heading without rapid drift. Pitch and roll are preserved.
safety_action: Drop yaw column during feature extraction.
